title: Scene Regression Manifest
description: Project-level manifest at <project_root>/doc/scene-regression.json defining which scenes to regress, how to boot them, and what to compare.

boot_mode.description: How to deterministically reach this scene

capture_kind.description: screenshot=single PNG, evidence_bundle=canonical capture for the project. For V2 projects this normally means screenshot+sram (MDRT); legacy pipelines may also include visual_vdp_dump.bin.

capture_frame.description: Frame number at which to capture

capture_hold_frame.description: Optional QA-only scene frame at which the ROM freezes scene simulation after SRAM bootstrap so capture is deterministic.

warmup_frames.description: Frames to wait before scene is stable

baseline_root.description: Relative path from project root to the baseline directory for this scene

tolerance_threshold.description: For tolerant mode: max fraction of differing pixels (0.0-1.0)

required_artifacts.description: Which artifacts must be present in the captured evidence bundle. This gates presence only; it does not define baseline diff behavior.

comparison_artifacts.description: Which artifacts are compared against the baseline. Defaults to ['screenshot'] when omitted.

navigation_sequence.description: BlastEm navigation commands to reach this scene

expected_app_scene_id.description: App-defined scene ID expected in MDRT block after capture

bootstrap_scene_id.description: Scene ID to write into SRAM bootstrap payload for sram_bootstrap boot mode
